verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing has a first-party Entitlements doc page about granting or revoking product feature access to customers, so the capability is documented. Its depth is not shown in the evidence. Missing for 10: evidence that features and limits are modeled and attached to products or plans, a documented runtime API/SDK endpoint for checking a customer's active entitlements, limit/quota semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, features and limits are modeled as entitlements attached to plans, and my application can check a customer's entitlements at runtime via API or SDK

citations.quote: Determine when you can grant or revoke product feature access to customers.
